edges.reason: The _a address parameter flows into setAttribute which writes attributes[_a].
The _att_name parameter indexes canonical and per-NFT attribute mappings in setAttribute.
The _att_value parameter is stored into the attribute mapping by setAttribute.
The _quantity parameter drives the reserve() minting loop count.
The _user parameter is written into the whitelisted mapping by whitelistUser.
The _state parameter is written into the paused flag by pause.
The _newBaseExtension parameter is stored into baseExtension.
The _base parameter is stored into the base URI variable.
The _msig parameter is cast and stored into the msig payout address.
The _creators parameter is cast and stored into the creators payout address.
The _canonical parameter is used to look up attCanonical.isCanonical.
msg.sender controls the payment branch and is the mint recipient in createCollectible.
msg.sender indexes the whitelisted mapping to bypass the mint cost.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause is protected by onlyOwner which validates msg.sender against the owner.
withdraw is protected by onlyOwner which validates msg.sender against the owner.
reserve is protected by onlyOwner which validates msg.sender against the owner.
block.timestamp is hashed into the random() candidate, creating timestamp dependency.
random() output is a predictable, miner-influenceable value used as the mint candidate.
random() reduces the hash modulo maxSupply to pick the candidate.
createCollectible invokes random() to choose a candidate.
reserve invokes random() for each reserved NFT.
createCollectible triggers the ERC721 safe mint external receiver call before tokenCounter increment.
The external receiver call is performed by _checkOnERC721Received, giving control to the recipient.
onERC721Received is invoked with _msgSender() as the operator, a reentry vector.
withdraw sends native funds to creators, a value transfer sink.
withdraw sends native funds to msig, a value transfer sink.
The creators address variable is the destination of the transfer.
The msig address variable is the destination of the transfer.
createCollectible reads the paused flag as a live-campaign guard.
createCollectible requires msg.value to be at least cost.
createCollectible reads and writes metadatas to avoid duplicate candidates.
createCollectible uses maxSupply in the modulo candidate loop.
createCollectible reads and increments tokenCounter for the new token id.
createCollectible writes the candidate string into tokenIdtoCandidate.
pause writes the paused state variable.
whitelistUser sets whitelisted[_user] to true.
removeWhitelistUser sets whitelisted[_user] to false.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension variable.
tokenURI reads the base URI to build the token metadata string.
tokenURI reads tokenIdtoCandidate to embed the candidate in the URI.
setBaseURI writes the base variable.
reserve reads and increments tokenCounter while minting.
reserve writes metadatas to mark reserved candidates.
reserve writes tokenIdtoCandidate for each reserved token.
withdraw uses cost in the baseFunds computation.
withdraw uses tokenCounter to compute total minted funds.
setAttribute reads and writes the attCanonical struct.
setAttribute writes the attributes mapping for the NFT.
getAttribute reads attributes[_a].attData.
isAtt reads attributes[_a].isAtt.
isAttCanonical reads attCanonical.isCanonical.
getAllCanonicalAttributes reads attCanonical.canonicals.
getAllAttributes iterates attCanonical.canonicals.
getAllAttributes reads attributes[_a].attData values.
resetAttributes deletes and clears the attributes data.
resetAttributes iterates attCanonical.canonicals to delete entries.
removeCanonical mutates the attCanonical struct and array.
nonReentrant reads and writes the _status guard variable.
_safeMint calls _mint to create ownership records.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs the external recipient call.
createCollectible calls _safeMint to mint the NFT.
reserve calls _safeMint for each reserved token.
setAttribute calls isAtt to check existing attribute state.
setAttribute calls isAttCanonical to check attribute registration.
getAllCanonicalAttributes calls isAttCanonical while filtering the list.
getAllAttributes calls isAttCanonical while building the result.
removeCanonical calls isAttCanonical as a precondition check.
Address.functionDelegateCall executes untrusted target code that can invoke arbitrary functions.

normalization_plan.reason: Address parameter only exists to index the attributes mapping inside setAttribute.
Attribute name parameter is a transient index into canonical and NFT attribute mappings.
Attribute value parameter is immediately stored and has no independent meaning.
Quantity parameter only bounds the reserve() minting loop.
Whitelist user parameter is only used to write whitelisted[_user].
State parameter is only assigned to the paused flag.
String parameter is immediately assigned to baseExtension.
String parameter is immediately assigned to the base URI variable.
Address parameter is only cast and stored into msig.
Address parameter is only cast and stored into creators.
Canonical name parameter is only used for the isCanonical lookup.
Candidate is a temporary randomness result local to the mint flow.
New item id is a transient alias of tokenCounter during minting.
Storage pointer local only used to write attributes inside setAttribute.
Length local only bounds the canonical attribute iteration.
Derived split amount consumed immediately by the creators transfer.
Derived remainder consumed immediately by the msig transfer.
Index local only tracks the array position removed in removeCanonical.
Return buffer local only exists to build the canonical attribute list.
Return buffer local only exists to build the NFT attribute list.
